docs.title: Week of September 16, 2025
docs.text: 🎯 Key Accomplishments   ### CEC FINOPS - ✅ Completed cost optimization analysis for AWS resources   ### CLOUD NATIVE - ✅ Migrated 3 additional applications to containerized architecture   ### TPV - ✅ Automated 80% of validation test cases   ### CEC SLINGSHOT - ✅ Added new API endpoints for third-party integrations  ### ITALY DEVOPS - ✅ Implemented infrastructure monitoring for Italy region      🚀 Upcoming Goals   ### Next Week Priorities - **CEC FINOPS**: Launch multi-cloud cost comparison dashboard - **CLOUD NATIVE**: Begin Phase 2 of cloud migration project - **TPV**: Deploy automated testing in production environment - **CEC SLINGSHOT**: Start development of platform v2.0 - **ITALY DEVOPS**: Implement advanced security monitoring tools
